app.title: Purchasing Suite
app.demoNotice: No server detected, so the app is running on demo data. Anything you enter disappears when you reload. Run 'node server.js' to save your work.
settings.languageHint: Applies to menus and labels, not to your data.
settings.defaultHotelHint: Preselected when you add a record. You can still see both hotels.
settings.storageServer: Records are written to the data folder on the server.
settings.storageMemory: Records live in this browser tab only.
settings.roleHint: Everyone reads everything. You can edit only your own records.
ledger.weeklyHint: Average price per week, from the entry dates.
ledger.summaryHint: Across the hotels and category you selected.
ledger.comparisonHint: Widest supplier spread first — that is where negotiation room is.
ledger.compareHotelsHint: Same product, different price. Only products priced at both hotels appear.
ledger.emptyHint: Add the first price for this period with the button above.
ledger.noOverlapHint: Price the same product at both hotels to compare them.
rfq.summaryHint: Non-food requests and the quotes against them.
rfq.requestsHint: Biggest gap between cheapest and dearest quote first.
rfq.emptyHint: Add the first quote for this period with the button above.
closing.intro: Close the period once the data is complete. This screen reads Ledger and RFQ; it does not change them.
closing.checklistHint: Recorded for {otel}. Each tick is saved under your name.
closing.check.prices: All price entries for the period are in
closing.check.quotes: Open quotes decided or carried over
closing.coverageHint: How many active products got a price this period.
closing.noComparisonHint: The previous period has no matching products.
closing.hotelGapHint: Same product, same period, different price.
closing.selectAllHotelsHint: This panel compares hotels, so it needs both.
closing.quotesHint: Anything still open carries into next period.
closing.contributionHint: Entry counts per person for this period.
error.readOnly: You can edit only your own entries.
error.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the server and try again.
